title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
**About the Role** 
 : Executive – Quality Assurance
 



  





**Responsibilities** 
 :
 



  




* Management and control of document, Quality assurance procedure \& SOPs.
* Control, Review and issuance of work instructions, SOPs, QSPs \& artwork etc.
* Preparation and review of procedure, QSPs, qualification and validation protocol.
* Preparation and analysis of quality trends.
* Handling of change control management system and non\-conformity of product.
* Conduct internal audit, supplier quality audit and support in external audit.
* Review of correction, corrective action and preventive action including effectiveness monitoring.
* Review and follow\-up with internal department for external and internal calibrations as per schedule.
* Review/approve of proof check, print proof and artwork.
* Review the batch manufacturing Record.
* Provide training related to GMPs, QSPs, SOPs etc.
* Communicate and update the work instructions.
* Support in the investigation of non\-conformity and market complaint.
* Collect the data for management review meeting \& data analysis.
* Review of all quality test reports, printing specification and trends.
* Provide training to Microbiological procedure, GLP, QSPs, SOPs, GMP etc.
* Responsibility to review and release of batch release.



  





**Qualifications** 
 : Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Life Sciences preferred
 



  





**Required Skills** 
 :
 



  




* Technical files as per the requirement of EUMDR
* Preparing Technical files as per the requirement of MDD and ensure the compliance with the MDD requirements for class I, IIa, IIb and class III medical devices
* Preparation and review of Design History File, Clinical Evaluation Report, PMS Report, PSUR, PMCF report etc.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 
 : Full time
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 
 : We are committed to diversity and inclusivity.

title: Senior System Integration Tester (TT50SI RM 4446)
description:
**Position: Senior System Integration Tester (TT50SI RM 4446\)**
**Look for Manesar** 
**based candidates. First round virtual and second may be F2F**
**Responsibilities And Duties**
 The System Integration Tester (SIT) is responsible for executing all activities related to the System Integration test scope defined as part of TSC operations, in line with internal standard best practices, constantly adhering to Delivery, Quality, and Costs objectives. He / She will be a part of the System Integration Area
   

  

**Qualifications : Bachelor of Engineering degree in Electronics/Electrical
   

  

 Experience : 4 to 6 years’ experience in Infotainment System \\Cluster \\ADAS Validation**
**Skills And Competencies**
 Must Have:
   

  

* Relevant understanding of Key automotive system areas: HW, SW, Mechanics, Optics, Diagnostic
* Product architecture knowledge (Infotainment, Cluster, ADAS, etc )
* ASPICE, Agile methodology and techniques.ISO26262
* Capacity of synthesis for technical planning issues Experience in usage of Oscilloscope, Pico\-scope and multi\-meter.
* Capability to analyze HW schematics.
* Requirements Management Tool (ALM, tool, Interenterprise Architect) Atlassian Suite (Jira, Confluence).
* Handson Experience of Toolchain: Vector Canoe


**Nice To Have**
* Experience of working in Scrum team in Agile methodology.
* Experience in STLC (Software Testing life cycle)
* Experience in ASPICE SYS4 \&SYS5
* Experience in System Integration Testing


**Responsibilities**
* System Integration test of all components of the system (HW, Mechanics, Optics, SW, Calibration,) according to product architecture and defined by requirements and architecture team.
* System integration tests pattern/sequences creation and execution according to the defined strategy in line with test standards.
* Design, review and execute test cases for Hardware\-Software Interface in\-line with requirements defined by System architecture
* Design, review and execute test cases for Technical Safety Concept\\System Requirement (ISO 26262\) in line with requirements defined by System architecture.
* Definition of system integration automation test strategy using internally defined Test automation environment.
* Review and verify System Architecture Design from a testability perspective.
* Ensure traceability from System Architecture, including System Interfaces and Technical Safety concepts, requirements to the System Integration Test Cases.
* Design, review and execute System Integration Test Cases according to the Test Plan and define strategic
* Implement automated test cases in the defined Automated Test Environment.
* Generate System Integration Test Reports in line with Forvia Standards.
* Perform re\-use analysis effectively across the system integration test scope of work.
* Open System Integration defects and track their progress for closure effectively.
* Define the test environment and needed instrumentation to execute System Integration Test Cases


**Mindset/Attitude**
* Goal Oriented.
* Proactively work across teams with strong communication skills.
* Continues improvement.
* Team mentorship/building.
* Communication skills, clarity and transparency in management reporting
* Ability to simplify and summarize problems.
* Quality oriented work and Customer focus

title: AM/ DM -Quality
description:
Your activities
   

  

* Conduct real\-time inspections during different stages of manufacturing to ensure compliance with
* quality standards, specifications, and procedures,
* Detect and report defects or non\-conformities in products or processes, and work with production
* teams to address and resolve these issues immediately
* Develop and execute quality control plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and checklists to
* ensure consistent inspection and adherence to quality standards
* Collect and analyze data from inspections to identify trends, potential issues, and areas for
* improvement.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions
* Maintain detailed inspection records, generate quality reports, and provide feedback to stakeholders
* on quality performance and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure all quality processes comply with industry standards, ISO 9001 \& customer requirements


 Your profile
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in the quality process and manufacturing process inspection
* with the relevant manufacturing.
* Proficiency in using quality tools such as FMEA, RCA, etc


 Benefits:
   

  

* Work\-life integration
* Mobile working
* Flexible working hours
* Good development opportunities
* Employee discounts
* Attractive remuneration system
* Health initiatives


 The WIKA Group is among the world leaders in measurement technology with its products and services. With excellent sensing solutions, we enable safe, efficient and sustainable processes. And this for more than 75 years. More than 11,000 employees are currently committed towards this end.
   

  

 Together we meet the megatrends of demographic change, digitalisation and sustainability. This brings with it challenges, and many opportunities. Innovation and growth arise from new perspectives and ideas. What are yours? Join us on the way to a better future.
